title: Law-Rag public deterministic CI quality gates
scope: Repository-safe deterministic gates only. The Stage 11A schema smoke verifies harness integrity; the Stage 7 10-case CURATED_EXCERPT retrieval benchmark provides retrieval regression metrics. These thresholds are not general legal-accuracy claims.

gates.rationale: The benchmark harness smoke is deterministic and every checked-in schema case must continue to evaluate successfully.
Every assertion in the public harness smoke must remain compatible with the versioned evaluator.
The public schema smoke must keep representing all nine Stage 11A task families.
Preserves the existing Stage 7 Recall@5 regression threshold on the named 10-case public CURATED_EXCERPT benchmark.
Preserves the existing Stage 7 MRR regression threshold on the named public retrieval benchmark.
Every explicit-article case currently present in the named public benchmark must keep the expected exact Legal Evidence candidate pinned at rank 1.
